purpose: One bounded synthetic isolation smoke, not semantic RAG/LLM quality evaluation

preconditions.requirement: Prevent opposing stack imports before any native load, in both import orders; prove with stubs without native imports
preconditions.qualification: Guarded worker/vector entrypoints proven with fake modules; direct loader remains to guard

preconditions.requirement: Review Torch/sentence_transformers/sklearn native dependencies and refuse second distinct OpenMP runtime before load; no KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK/system patches
Review exact GO-generated guard changes, process boundary and output capture bounds; retain tested model pin
Report conditions/results of mock guard tests before approving/executing a single native attempt; no automatic retries

texts: Synthetic community AI workshop for young adults.
Synthetic maintenance schedule for a public library.

isolation.parent: stdlib only; no Torch/FAISS/sklearn imports; OS network denied
isolation.embedding_child: fresh Python -I -B, offline/clean env without keys, no FAISS allowed; model files read-only; only own temp output
isolation.vector_child: separate fresh process after embedding child exits; FAISS only, no Torch/sentence_transformers/sklearn; consume precomputed vectors and same-vector query
isolation.production_server: do not touch localhost8501, user SQLite or password

pass_criteria: child PIDs distinct from parent and each other
two finite nonzero384dim vectors and exact pinned identity
no opposing Python stack or duplicate OpenMP images in either child
FAISS nearest-self match from frozen vector fixture, not semantic quality claim
owned children stopped; no network/secret/user-data access
failure_handling: Abort once on timeout/nonzero/signal/invalid JSON/runtime collision, capture sanitized PID/exit/signal metadata, no retry or hidden crash. Keep DEMO independent.
blocker: ST/Transformers sklearn import paths would be rejected; direct loader and physical-runtime/output-capture review incomplete
